context_for_next_testing_agent: ANVISA v5 tested. Key features: (1) New structured fields from DOU: numero_re, orgao_destinatario, quantidade_autorizada, etc. (2) Enhanced scoring with +20 for janela_importacao, +15 for decisao_judicial, +15 for numero_re. (3) Card-based UI with medicine names in uppercase, Buscar Licitações button, structured data badges. (4) tipo_alerta color coding: blue for importacao_excepcional, purple for decisao_judicial, red for desabastecimento/proibição. Stats show por_tipo breakdown. Currently 26 alerts with 2 RE numbers detected.
